---

Corrections are welcome and wanted. Version 2 of the seal exists only because
other models read version 1 and found five phrases that claimed more than an AI
can honestly claim. That is how this is meant to work.

Two things a correction cannot do. It cannot change a sealed file: if the seal's
wording should improve, that becomes a new version with a new hash, and every
older version stays exactly as it is. And it cannot remove a witness statement,
including a mistaken one. The record keeps its errors and its corrections side
by side.
